proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: The note had eleven findings, eight marked OK, two to watch and one to fix: a bent cap mesh. Ingrid said the watch items could wait a year, and wrote down exactly what to look for.
reviews.name: Brent A.

reviews.text: Our buyer's inspector asked for a camera look. The report came back in two days with video of the whole flue and a clear line saying it was fine to use. The sale closed on time.
reviews.name: Colleen R.

reviews.text: Ceiling stain next to the chimney after the spring rain. They found the chase cover had rusted through, sent me a photo from the roof, and swapped it the next week.
reviews.name: Ravi S.

reviews.text: Our gas insert would not stay lit in December. They cleaned the pilot and the thermocouple, checked the vent, and showed me what the flame should look like next time.
reviews.name: Tanya F.

reviews.text: New stove in our Tumalo cabin. They measured the clearances to the log wall, put it on the note, and set the hearth pad so it reached far enough out front. We heat the whole place with it now.
reviews.name: Hank W.

reviews.text: We burn juniper and pine, mostly pine. They swept the pipe in March instead of October because of how much we burn, and the note said why.
reviews.name: Jolene C.

proof.guarantee: If a finding on your note turns out wrong, we come back and fix that part at no charge.

prices.note: labor, pipe and pad, stove not included
